description.purpose: Keeps every finished digest on the shelf (./store) with the round of the run that made it, and answers a read of the kept digests (GH #976).
description.use_when: After ./format (keep) and on the hive's in_read lane (op last).
description.not_in_scope: It invents no round: a run demanded without context.digest_round is kept with an empty round, which covers no screen; a scheduled run is kept with the holder mark and shown only under the member's round the builder's read edge stamps. It reads no other table.
description.emits_meaning: messages[]: a store tool_call (insert on keep, select on a read; hop.route shelf_store), or the one answer of a read: hop.route answer with op and op_id mirrored, body {ok, op, digests: [{id, at, when, title, items, lead, audience_set}]} newest first -- only the digests whose round covers the asking round -- or {ok: false, error: {code: unknown_op | no_round | store_error}}.
description.consumes_meaning: messages[]: the formatted digest (assistant text), a read (hop.route in_read, context.shelf_origin read, context.shelf_op_id, context.audience_set), or the store's tool_result over the edge back from the store (an insert receipt is swallowed).
examples: 'Daily digest:\nA. B.' with context.digest_round '["member:p"]' -> insert {title: 'Daily digest', items: ['A.', 'B.'], audience_set: '["member:p"]'}
